figures.caption: Metabolic activity after the addition of bat cathelicidin-derived peptides against Mucor hiemalis KCTC 26779. ΔHA-CATH, ΔML-CATH, and ΔPD-CATH are the predicted antimicrobial activity core region peptides of Hipposideros armiger (accession number, XP_019486615.1), Myotis lucifugus (accession number, XP_006108360.2), and Phyllostomus discolor (accession number, XP_028374415.1) cathelicidins, respectively. HA-CATH, ML-CATH, and PD-CATH are the predicted nascent mature region peptides. Statistical significance was indicated above bars; a (p < 0.01) and b (p < 0.001).
